news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该插件因未直接依赖 httpx，在 LLM 0.33 切换到 httpx2 后失效，现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 说明底层 HTTP 客户端变更可能影响未显式声明依赖的插件。
news.summary_en: A plugin that broke when LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2, because it used httpx without depending on it directly, has been fixed.
news.why_it_matters_en: Shows how a change in an underlying HTTP client can break plugins that don't declare that dependency.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: 这个调试插件提供一个不涉及真实 LLM、只回显提示词的“模型”；新版本更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以计入工具调用、系统提示和推理。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 有助于在不调用真实模型的情况下更准确地测试 token 用量相关逻辑。
news.summary_en: The debug plugin provides a 'model' that doesn't involve an LLM and just repeats prompts; the release updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning.
news.why_it_matters_en: Makes it easier to test token-usage behavior without calling a real model.

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

news.why_it_matters_zh: 暴露的配置和权限是代理被滥用的实际入口，凸显云与应用配置安全的重要性。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: Exposed configuration and permissions were the actual entry points, highlighting the importance of cloud and app configuration security.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 英伟达前高管称物理 AI 不止是机器人，他如今正投资该领域
news.summary_zh: 在英伟达机器人平台产品营销部门工作七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 称，机器人目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一看法与认为通用基础模型将直接推动机器人发展的观点不同，强调基础组件仍待完善。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA's robotics platforms, says robotics is in its 'Lego era,' with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.
news.why_it_matters_en: The view contrasts with those who believe general foundation models will directly drive robotics, stressing that basic components still need work.

news.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them

news.why_it_matters_zh: 这是厂商自评结果，若成立则表明新模型在特定视觉推理任务上具有竞争力，但仍需独立验证。
news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.why_it_matters_en: These are vendor-reported results; if they hold, they suggest competitive performance on specific visual reasoning tasks, but independent verification is still needed.

top5.title_zh: Replit 将 OpenAI 设为默认模型，CEO 称
top5.title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch 报道，Replit CEO Amjad Masad 表示 OpenAI 已取代 Anthropic 成为平台默认模型提供商；Claude 仍向客户提供。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch reports Replit CEO Amjad Masad said OpenAI has replaced Anthropic as the platform's default model provider; Claude remains available to customers.
top5.why_zh: 默认模型会影响构建者的成本、延迟、能力边界和迁移工作，是平台生态竞争的直接信号。
top5.why_en: Default models shape builders' cost, latency, capability limits and migration work, making this a direct signal in platform ecosystem competition.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 故事本身明确，但影响取决于默认路由、定价和可用性细节；不要把“默认”理解为“唯一”。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The story is clear, but impact depends on default routing, pricing and availability details; do not read “default” as “exclusive.”
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：构建者可重新评估模型路由与多模型备份；风险：单点默认切换可能带来成本和兼容性变化。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: builders can reassess model routing and multi-model fallbacks; risk: a single default switch may bring cost and compatibility changes.
top5.action_zh: 若在 Replit 上构建，检查项目默认模型与回退配置后再部署。
top5.action_en: If building on Replit, verify the project's default model and fallback settings before deploying.
top5.original_title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says

top5.title_zh: 印度报告失控 AI 智能体活动

top5.what_zh: TechCrunch 报道印度成为最新报告失控 AI 智能体活动的国家；智能体通过应用配置、公共代码库中暴露的凭据/连接设置以及过度宽松的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch reports India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 智能体安全从理论风险变成可操作的基础设施卫生问题，构建者需要审计凭据与权限。
top5.why_en: Agent security is moving from theoretical risk to practical infrastructure hygiene, requiring builders to audit credentials and permissions.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 事件细节有限，但攻击面具体：配置泄露、代码库泄密、云权限过宽。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Incident details are limited, but the attack surface is concrete: exposed configuration, repository secrets and overly broad cloud permissions.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：安全审计与最小权限工具需求上升；风险：低估非人类身份与连接配置的暴露面。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: demand may rise for security audits and least-privilege tools; risk: underestimating exposure from non-human identities and connection settings.
top5.action_zh: 审计应用配置、公共仓库密钥和云角色权限，轮换暴露凭据并收紧权限。
top5.action_en: Audit app configurations, public-repo secrets and cloud role permissions; rotate exposed credentials and tighten permissions.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是 AI 竞争从模型能力转向平台默认、人才与治理结构，同时智能体安全成为落地约束。
editorial.core_en: The throughline is AI competition shifting from model capability to platform defaults, talent and governance structures, while agent security becomes a deployment constraint.
editorial.trend_zh: 模型提供商通过默认集成和公司治理安排争夺生态位；智能体事故推动最小权限与凭据卫生。
editorial.trend_en: Model providers are competing for ecosystem position through default integrations and corporate-governance arrangements; agent incidents are pushing least privilege and credential hygiene.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当默认模型可被平台随时替换、智能体权限又难以审计时，构建者应如何设计可迁移且可审计的 AI 架构？
editorial.next_question_en: When platforms can switch default models and agent permissions are hard to audit, how should builders design portable and auditable AI architectures?
